weekLabel.zh: 近期更新 · 11 月 11 日 – 11 月 17 日（发售周）

title.zh: 评测解禁倒计时：传 11/18 20:00（北京时间）出分，内部人士称「低于 9 分都值得怀疑」
title.en: Review Embargo Countdown: Scores Reportedly Land Nov 18 at 20:00 Beijing Time, Insider Says "Anything Below 9 Is Suspect"

summary.zh: Insider Gaming 与 NateTheHate 相互印证 11/18 解禁，时间与 R 星前两作「发售前一天」惯例吻合；另有内部评测人士给出高分预期。Rockstar 从未官宣，一切属第三方爆料。
summary.en: Insider Gaming and NateTheHate corroborate a Nov 18 embargo, matching Rockstar's day-before-launch pattern; an internal reviewer offers a high-score expectation. Rockstar has never officially announced it — all third-party leaks.

title.zh: Metacritic 上那个 6.5 分是 5 个人打出来的：发售前两天遭「提前评分轰炸」
title.en: That 6.5 on Metacritic Is Five Ratings: Pre-Release Review-Bombing Two Days Out

summary.zh: 游戏尚未解锁、媒体分 11/18 才出，用户分却已有 6.5——但分母只有 5 个、仅 2 个正面。这个数字毫无统计意义，真正的口碑要等解禁后。
summary.en: The game has not unlocked and critic scores arrive Nov 18, yet the user score already reads 6.5 — from just five ratings, two positive. Statistically meaningless; real reception comes after the embargo.

title.zh: 发售前 72 小时最终检查清单：预载、空间、解锁时间与新海报，一样别漏
title.en: Final 72-Hour Checklist: Preload, Storage, Unlock Times and the New Poster — Nothing to Miss

summary.zh: 按时间顺序汇总发售周所有实操要点：确认预载、预留补丁空间、记牢解锁时刻、11/18 评测、11/19 免费海报与地图、11/20 奖励截止。
summary.en: A chronological rundown of every launch-week practical: confirm preload, leave patch room, know your unlock time, Nov 18 reviews, Nov 19 free poster and map, Nov 20 bonus deadline.

title.zh: 官方敲定技术规格：主机版锁定 30 帧，PS5 Pro 获 PSSR 与光追，Xbox 支持云游戏
title.en: Official Specs: 30fps on Consoles, PSSR and Ray Tracing on PS5 Pro, Cloud Streaming on Xbox

summary.zh: Rockstar 确认 PS5/Xbox 目标 30 帧、无 60 帧模式；PS5 Pro 独享 PSSR 与光追阴影；DualSense 触觉与 3D 音效完整支持；Xbox One 可云游戏。PC 仍无日期。
summary.en: Rockstar confirms a 30fps console target with no 60fps mode; PSSR and ray-traced shadows exclusive to PS5 Pro; full DualSense haptics and 3D audio; Xbox One cloud streaming. Still no PC date.

title.zh: 官方确认：GTA6 盒装兑换码版全球到店，但盒子里没有光盘
title.en: Official: GTA 6 Code-in-Box Editions Are Now in Stores Worldwide — With No Disc Inside

summary.zh: Rockstar 11/12 确认盒装版全球上架。盒内只有下载码、无光盘，仍需下载 212GB；11/20 前购买仍获 Vintage Vice City Pack 预购奖励。
summary.en: Rockstar confirmed Nov 12 that boxed editions are in stores worldwide. The box holds a code, not a disc, and still needs the 212GB download; buying before Nov 20 keeps the Vintage Vice City Pack bonus.

title.zh: 官方确认：GTA6 预载 11 月 10 日开放、最多 212GB——此前的 11/12 与 210GB 口径作废
title.en: Official: GTA 6 Preload Starts November 10 at Up to 212GB — the Earlier November 12 and 210GB Figures Are Superseded

summary.zh: Rockstar 公告：PS5 按各地零点、Xbox 按 GMT 零点于 11/10 开放数字预载，最多 212GB；盒装码版 11/12 起提货，11/19 各时区零点解锁。
summary.en: Rockstar's announcement: digital preload opened Nov 10 at local midnight on PS5 and 00:00 GMT on Xbox, up to 212GB. Code-in-box pickup from Nov 12 and local-midnight unlock on Nov 19.

title.zh: Take-Two 财报：GTA6 开发已完成、预购「远超预期」，Q3 净预订预计接近翻倍
title.en: Take-Two Q2 Results: GTA 6 Development Is Complete, Pre-Orders "Far Above" Forecast, Q3 Net Bookings Set to Nearly Double

summary.zh: Zelnick 确认 Rockstar 已完成开发、营销完全就绪，并对 IGN 明说「不会再延期」。仍未公布官方预购数字与 PC 版日期。
summary.en: Zelnick says Rockstar has finished development with marketing fully ready, and told IGN the game will not be delayed again. Still no official pre-order figure or PC date.

title.zh: GTA6 发售倒计时日历：从 11/3 官方预载公告到 11/19 解锁，节点全记录（持续更新）
title.en: GTA 6 Launch Countdown Calendar: Every Milestone From the November 3 Preload Announcement to the November 19 Unlock (Live)

summary.zh: 按时间顺序记录全部节点并标注状态：11/3 预载公告、11/10 数字预载、11/12 盒装码提货、11/18 评测解禁、11/19 解锁、11/20 特典截止。
summary.en: Every milestone in order with its status: Nov 3 preload announcement, Nov 10 digital preload, Nov 12 code-in-box pickup, Nov 18 reviews, Nov 19 unlock, Nov 20 bonus deadline.
